# Contributor Licence Agreement — signatures

This file is the **index** of who has accepted the
[Resonans Individual Contributor Licence Agreement](legal/individual-cla.md).
**It is not the evidence.** The evidence is the pull request each contributor opened
**from their own GitHub account** to add their own line, and the commit they authored in it.
A line someone else added proves nothing, so the `CLA` check refuses a line whose user ID
is not the pull request author's.

How to sign, and what signing means: [CONTRIBUTING.md → Licensing of contributions](CONTRIBUTING.md#licensing-of-contributions).
Read clause 8 there before you sign: **this record is public and permanent.**

One line per contributor, appended at the end. Existing lines are never edited or removed;
a correction is a new line (see clause 8).

| GitHub | User ID | Date | CLA version |
|---|---|---|---|
| @alice | 1234567 | 2026-10-20 | cla-1.0 (a1b2c3d) |

base_corporate:
# Corporate CLA signatures

This file is the **index** of companies that have signed the
[Resonans Corporate Contributor Licence Agreement](corporate-cla.md), and of the persons
each one covers (its Schedule). **The company signs, not the person**, so a person listed
here has not signed the individual agreement and is not in [CLA.md](../CLA.md). The
signed agreement itself is held by KlangHaus; a maintainer checks it before merging a
change to this file.

Each company is a `##` line — company · company number · signatory, role · date ·
version — followed by a table of the persons it covers, by GitHub username and numeric
user ID. Lines are only ever added: a person is added to a company's table by its
written notice (clause 3), and removing a person does not affect contributions already
made, so a removal is recorded as a note, not by deleting the row.

The form, indented here so the check does not read it as a signature (the check only
reads lines that start at the left margin):

    ## Example ApS · CVR 12345678 · Jane Doe, CEO · 2026-10-28 · ccla-1.0

    | GitHub | User ID |
    |---|---|
    | @jane-doe | 1234567 |

First company below this line.
